name: XAT
conductingBody: XLRI - Xavier School of Management, Jamshedpur (on behalf of XAMI - Xavier Association of Management Institutes)
eligibility: A recognized Bachelor's degree of at least three years' duration or its equivalent in any discipline. Candidates appearing for their final exams by June 11, 2027 are also eligible to apply. All Indian candidates must appear for XAT 2027; NRI, Foreign, OCI and PIO candidates may apply (to XLRI) through GMAT.
mode: Computer-based test ("conducted online" per XLRI Admission Prospectus 2027; exam in English, MCQs with five options as per XAT 2026 official instructions)
frequency: Once per cycle: a single test date (Sunday, January 03, 2027, 2:00 PM to 5:00 PM) across 100+ test cities

sections.name: Part 1 - Verbal Ability and Logical Reasoning (VA & LR)
Part 1 - Quantitative Aptitude and Data Interpretation (QA & DI)

pattern.marking: Part 1: +1 for each correct answer, -0.25 for each incorrect answer, and -0.10 for each un-attempted question after 12 un-attempted questions. Part 2 (GK): +1 for each correct answer, no negative marking for incorrect answers.
pattern.notes: Question counts are given officially as 'About' 26/21/28/20 (XAT 2027 Quick Overview). Part 1 (three sections) shares 170 minutes with no sectional time limits; Part 2 (GK) has 10 minutes. GK scores are used exclusively by XLRI for its final selection process. PwD candidates get an additional 20 minutes for every hour. FAQ: candidates may begin with any section and switch between sections. The scrolling homepage notice showing 'January 5, 2027' is commented out in the page source and conflicts with the Bulletin/Prospectus/FAQ (January 03, 2027), so it is ignored.

syllabusAreas: Verbal Ability and Logical Reasoning: critical and analytical reasoning, reading comprehension (including poems, cartoons and passages), vocabulary, English grammar, para jumbles, cloze tests
Decision Making: scenarios from personal and professional lives requiring critical thinking, problem-solving and prioritization
Quantitative Aptitude: arithmetic, algebra, geometry, mensuration, modern maths
Data Interpretation: interpretation, summarization and analysis of data
General Knowledge: 8 questions on static GK and 12 on current affairs

registrationFee.category: Additional fee per XLRI programme applied to (through XAT)
Indian candidates applying to XLRI PGDM (GM) through GMAT/GRE
NRI/Foreign/PIO/OCI candidates applying to one or more XLRI programmes through GMAT

resultAndCounselling: Results are announced on xatonline.in about three weeks after the exam (last week of January 2027); the score card must be downloaded from xatonline.in between January 31 and June 30, 2027 (no hard copy is sent). There is no centralised counselling. For XLRI, candidates select programmes in the same XAT application; shortlisting for interviews in PGDM (BM) and PGDM (HRM) is based only on XAT scores, and final selection considers XAT performance (including GK), academic background, relevant work experience, personal interview and/or group discussion, extracurricular activities and other criteria. Other institutes using XAT scores run their own application and selection processes and decide their own weightages; XLRI has no role in them.
